about: Read the photo (#198, #245): what on-device text recognition gave for a fraction glyph, measured on shared/fixtures/reddit/photos/card-fractions-*.jpg (docs/decisions.md, #245). A look-alike in an amount's place (the start of a line, or after a whole number; one with a letter only before a unit) is listed under Check these lines with the fractions as one-tap replacements, never changed by itself: '%' was 2/3 here and could be 1/2 or 3/4 elsewhere. Exact and case-sensitive; afterNumberOnly is a real word at a line's start ('a cup of milk'), so it counts only after a whole number ('1 a cups flour'). Language-independent.
